title: 第9章 英雄救美第10章 青梅竹马
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
清晨的乌林镇，宛如一位清丽脱俗的佳人，在晨曦的轻抚下渐渐苏醒，开始热闹起来。
街道两旁，早起的大爷大妈们勤劳的，纷纷摆起了摊位。
有卖蔬菜水果的，有卖地摊杂货的，琳琅满目的小物件，还有小吃摊位，阵阵香气扑鼻而来，仿佛是勾人味蕾。
各大商城门店也陆续敞开大门，迎接四方来客。
街道上，香味如轻纱般笼罩，热浪如清丝般四处流淌。
人来人往，如潮水般在大街上流转。
林道脸色苍白，宛如大病初愈般，走在大街上，却被这人间烟火味深深吸引。
上世的他，如孤独的行者，在城市的喧嚣中艰难求生，也曾如这些普通人一般，在烟火人间中苦苦寻觅生存。
想到这些，林道心神一阵恍惚，仿佛梦回曾经。
林道回过神来，嘴角泛起一丝苦涩的笑，终究是无法回去了。
他两世为人，一直都是形单影只，如没有线的风筝。
林道来到包子摊位前出声道：“老板，来20笼包子。”
不是他不想要更多，而是摊位上仅有这么多，其实这些只够他垫下肚子。
包子摊位老板脸上一愣，他还是第一次买包子，被人将所有包子一起端走的。
包子老板有些不确定道：“小伙子，你没开玩笑吧。”
他有些怀疑眼前的年轻人是来捣乱的。
林道那张苍白俊朗的面庞之上，缓缓地浮现出一抹和煦的笑容，他轻声说道：“放心吧，大叔！我没有骗你。”
自那日开发武技后，已然过去了三日之久。
在这三天时间里面，林道始终不懈磨炼着自己所掌握的武技。
林道也耗尽了老宅之中，存储的所有肉食，方才勉强让自己体内，那推演武技而亏空的，气血得以重新回满。

然而，精神层面的损耗，却是更为棘手和难以快速恢复。
尽管经过了这三天调养，但林道的精神状态也仅仅只是，恢复到了正常水平的一半而已。
对于精神力的修复，如今成为林道一块心病，令其倍感苦恼。
在这几日里，他思索着各种办法，只可惜最终所取得的成效，实在是微乎其微。
包子店的老板在听闻了，林道给出的肯定答复之后，顿时喜笑颜开，手脚麻利得迅速行动起来。
不到一会，便将那整整二十笼热气腾腾、香气四溢的美味包子通通打包完毕。
毕竟今日可是迎来了，如此一位出手阔绰的大客户，此刻他的心情好到了极点。
所以整个打包过程也是异常顺利，没过多久工夫，一切就都准备好了。
包子店老板的脸上，堆满了的笑容，热情对林道喊道：“嘿，小伙子，你所要的这二十笼包子全都给你打包好，总共二百块钱。”
林道表情倒是十分淡定，完全没有去在意周围那些，投来的充满讶异之色的目光。
或许是由于这样的场景经历得多了，他多多少少也，算是有点儿习以为常了吧。
只见他微微颔首示意，然后不慌不忙地从口袋中掏出手机，轻轻一扫，完成了支付操作。
这里的大夏也有手机支付这样的功能。
提着两个大袋子，走入人群中，林道脚下用力‘瞬步’刷一下，身影从人群消失不见。
在一座三层楼楼顶上，林道手拿包子快速吃起来，他脸上浮现轻松惬意的表情，好久没有这么舒适过。
自从来到这世界，他就一直忙着修炼，这二十多天以来，不是在修炼就是修炼的路上，只是偶尔有时间到镇上购买些物资。
那种对陌生环境的恐慌警惕不安，在二十多天忙碌修炼中一点点消磨，直到此时，林道才放下一切。
看着天空上温和的太阳，林道心中思索，自己再过些天就要去上大学了。
估计也该离开这里了，其实这乌云镇跟原主并不陌生，原主从小学到初中，基本都在这里上学。
后来原主父母因工作原因，才把原主接去省城，在那里完成高中就学。
content_en:
In the early morning, Wulin Town is like a beautiful and refined beauty, gradually waking up under the caress of the morning light and becoming lively.
On both sides of the street, the industrious uncles and aunties who got up early set up stalls one after another.
There are sellers of vegetables and fruits, street stalls selling groceries, a dazzling array of small items, and snack stalls. The aroma is fragrant and seems to tantalize the taste buds.
Stores in major shopping malls have also opened their doors one after another to welcome visitors from all over.
On the streets, the fragrance is shrouded like a veil, and the heat waves flow everywhere like clear silk.
People come and go, flowing on the street like a tide.
Lin Dao's face was pale, as if he had just recovered from a serious illness. As he walked on the street, he was deeply attracted by the smell of human fireworks.
In his previous life, he was like a lonely traveler, struggling to survive in the hustle and bustle of the city. He was also like these ordinary people, struggling to survive in the world of fireworks.
Thinking of this, Lin Dao felt in a trance, as if he was dreaming back to the past.
Lin Dao came back to his senses, with a bitter smile on his lips. After all, he couldn't go back.
In his two lives, he has always been alone, like a kite without strings.
Lin Dao came to the steamed bun stall and said, "Boss, here are 20 steamed buns."
It's not that he doesn't want more, it's just that there are only so many on the stall, and in fact these are just enough to satisfy his stomach.
The owner of the bun stall was stunned. This was his first time buying buns, and all the buns were taken away together.
The Baozi boss said a little uncertainly: "Young man, are you kidding me?"
He somewhat suspected that the young man in front of him was here to cause trouble.
A warm smile slowly appeared on Lin Dao's pale and handsome face, and he said softly: "Don't worry, uncle! I didn't lie to you."
Three days have passed since he developed his martial arts skills that day.
During these three days, Lin Dao continued to hone his martial arts skills.
Lin Dao also exhausted all the meat stored in the old house, and just barely managed to regain the energy and blood in his body that was depleted due to the martial arts.
However, mental damage is more difficult to recover from.
Despite these three days of recuperation, Lindao's mental state had only returned to half of its normal level.
The restoration of mental power has now become a worry for Lin Dao, making him feel even more distressed.
In the past few days, he thought about various methods, but unfortunately the results he achieved in the end were minimal.
After hearing the affirmative answer given by Lin Dao, the boss of the steamed stuffed bun shop suddenly beamed and acted quickly.
In less than a moment, all twenty cages of steaming, fragrant and delicious steamed buns were packed.
After all, today had ushered in such a big and generous customer, and he was in an extremely good mood at this moment.
So the whole packing process was extremely smooth, and it didn't take long before everything was ready.
With a smile on his face, the owner of the bun shop enthusiastically shouted to Lin Dao: "Hey, young man, all the twenty steamed buns you want will be packed for you, for a total of two hundred yuan."
Lin Dao's expression was very calm, and he didn't pay attention to the surprised looks from those around him.
Perhaps because he has experienced such scenes a lot, he is more or less accustomed to it.
He nodded slightly, then calmly took out his mobile phone from his pocket, swiped it lightly, and completed the payment operation.
Daxia here also has the function of mobile payment.
Carrying two big bags, he walked into the crowd. Lin Dao brushed his feet hard with his 'Shunbu', and his figure disappeared from the crowd.
On the roof of a three-story building, Lin Dao quickly ate the buns in his hand. A relaxed and comfortable expression appeared on his face. He had not felt so comfortable for a long time.
Since he came to this world, he has been busy cultivating. In the past twenty days, he has not been practicingCultivation is on the road of cultivation, and I only occasionally have time to go to the town to buy some supplies.
The panic, vigilance and uneasiness about the unfamiliar environment were gradually worn away during more than twenty days of busy practice. It was only then that Lin Dao let go of everything.
Looking at the gentle sun in the sky, Lin Dao thought to himself that he would go to college in a few days.
It's probably time to leave here. In fact, Wuyun Town is no stranger to the original owner. The original owner basically went to school here from elementary school to junior high school.
Later, due to work reasons, the original owner's parents took the original owner to the provincial capital and completed high school there.
